text: CachedStore defines _deleted as a Set on its prototype, so it is shared by instances unless an instance overrides it. markDeleted removes an ID only when setData resolves and does not attach a rejection handler there. The local source alone does not prove cross-engine ID uniqueness or recovery after write failure. Proposed review rule: inspect instance ownership, key scope and both promise outcomes for a temporary async guard. Do not describe this source as having a proven per-engine set or complete failure recovery.
title: Review the ownership and failure lifecycle of a temporary deletion guard
